values.note: Sites 1-60 (electric) $30 a night; addition sites 61-100 (water, sewer, electric) $40 a night, $1,050 a month or $3,600 for four months. Each extra family unit on a site pays an additional fee. Online cancellation costs $10 plus the reservation fee, refunded as credit; under 3 days out, nothing back.

fees.source: https://parks.pricecounty.wi.gov/parks/camping/solberg_lake_county_campground_sites_160/ ('Sites 1-60 are $30.00 per night'); .../addition_sites_61100/ ('Sites in addition can be reserved daily, 1 month or 4 months (40.00/night, $1050.00 & $3600.00)'); reservation policy PDF ('There will be a reservation fee of $10.00 per site'; cancellation terms; 'Additional family units may use the same site by paying an additional fee')

values.note: Sites 1-9, 43-60 and the 61-100 addition book online at least 8 days ahead; sites 10-42 are first come, first served, and any unreserved site may be self-registered at the pay station for up to 7 days or until the next reservation. Monthly and 4-month stays in the addition must be booked online. The 2-night minimum covers Thursday-Saturday on reservable sites; 3 nights on Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends.

values.note: Roads are not plowed in winter. Showers, flush toilets, pressure water and the dump run about early/mid May to early/mid October; potable water at the pumphouse until about November 30.

note: Price County park on a 35-acre peninsula in Solberg Lake. The 40-site addition (61-100) sits in an open field across West Solberg Lake Road, its facilities across the road in the main park; it also sells 1-month and 4-month stays. The county calls 20+ sites lakeside; the shore sites sit under trees behind a marsh fringe. Sand beach, paved boat ramp, two fishing piers; ATVs/UTVs may ride from every site to the Flambeau trail system. --Claude
summary: County reservation site, site pages, policy and maps read. 100 sites: 1-60 electric 30/50 at $30 (1-9, 43-60 reservable 8+ days out; 10-42 FCFS), addition 61-100 W/S/E at $40 (also monthly/4-month). Open year-round, roads unplowed in winter. Lakeview KEPT: the shore sites are under continuous canopy behind a 20-50 m marsh fringe, so not lakefront despite the county's 'lakeside' wording. Pin OK. Google 4.7 (193).
flags: Lakeview KEPT (no --AWH value): the county says '20+ lakeside campsites', but Esri imagery shows every shore site (east row 23-34 near 45.7622,-90.3660; 37-57 along the east shore near 45.7650,-90.3678; 14-19 on the west shore near 45.7633,-90.3683) under continuous tree canopy with a 20-50 m band of emergent marsh between the trees and open water. Under canopy = view at best; no lakefront upgrade. The county's 'lakeside' wording is a contrary operator claim (higher), noted but not supported on imagery. No official site photos found.

Not a split: the addition (61-100, N10933 West Solberg Lake Rd) is directly across West Solberg Lake Road from the main loop's north end (county map, 1 inch = 125 ft), sharing its showers, dump and pay station.
Long stays: the 40-site addition sells nights, 1 month or 4 months; sites 1-60 are nightly only. At least 60 of 100 sites are nightly: no long-stay concern.

OHV side (flag, not a drop): 'All campsites are ATV accessible. ATV/UTV trail access to the Solberg Trail which connects to the Flambeau Trail System'; rules allow ATV/UTV use on paved park roads. A general lake campground with ATV access, not a staging area.
